verdict.rationale: A government filing service holds user data and could publish a policy or control on AI-training use, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Akamai and Incapsula bot walls blocking crawlers at robots.txt. That is an edge-security behavior, not a documented user-facing opt-out or policy keeping user data out of AI training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
